mechanism_as_printed: The fuel surcharge cost is updated monthly.

The fuel surcharge for both domestic and international transport is updated monthly. The surcharge is the percentage of freight costs (excluding additional services) and is tied to the previous month's diesel consumer price index maintained by Statistics Finland.
The fuel surcharge can not be negative.
